criteria.text: Two bookings of the same room that overlap are rejected with Conflict and the first booking is kept.
Back-to-back bookings (one ends exactly when the next starts) are allowed.
A booking that starts in the past is rejected.
A booking longer than 4 hours is rejected; exactly 4 hours is allowed.
Cancelling a booking frees the slot so the same slot can be booked again.
A booking cannot be cancelled less than 1 hour before it starts; it stays booked.
